blocks.en: D.5 Decision Collapse Beyond Jailbreak Attacks
blocks.zh: D.5 越狱袭击后的碰撞决定

blocks.en: Decision collapse was not a phenomenon we set out to study. We did not anticipate that the decision would collapse at all, and so we had surveyed no prior work on it beyond the most basic accounts of instability in reinforcement learning. After identifying the failure in autonomous attackers and finding a signal that mitigates it, we then found that neither the failure nor the remedy is particular to jailbreak attacks. A discrete decision emitted by the policy and trained by reinforcement learning degenerates to a constant in several other settings, each of which proposes a remedy of its own. We group those reports below by where the decision sits and summarize the remedies they propose. Then, we note which of them we had already tried without knowing of them, with what result, and which do not transfer to a multi-turn attack.
blocks.zh: 决策崩溃并不是我们研究的对象。 我们没有预料到这项决定会完全崩溃,因此,我们除了对加强学习方面不稳定的最基本说法外,没有调查过以前就此开展的工作。 在查明自主攻击者的失败并找到缓解这种失败的信号后,我们发现失败和补救都不是特别针对越狱攻击的。 政策产生的、经过强化学习培训的个别决定在其他几种情况下退化为常数,每种情况都提出了自己的补救办法。 兹将这些报告归纳如下,并概述它们提议的补救办法。 然后,我们注意到,在不知道他们的情况下,我们已经尝试过其中的哪些,结果如何,哪些没有转向多回合攻击。

blocks.en: D.5.1 Collapse in Other Settings
blocks.zh: D.5.1 其他设置中的折叠

blocks.en: A control token selecting a reasoning mode. A reasoning model can be trained to choose, per query, between a long chain of thought and a direct answer, emitting that choice as a single control token before it answers. Trained with reinforcement learning, the token collapses. AdaCoT ( Lou et al., 2025 ) names the failure decision boundary collapse and describes it as the model reverting to homogeneous behavior, either always or never triggering the chain of thought. Thinkless ( Fang et al., 2025 ) reports the same collapse under vanilla GRPO, the number of long-chain responses falling below ten within 120 120 updates. ARM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) reports it over four reasoning formats as format collapse , and AdaThinking-E ( Wang et al., 2026 ) reports GRPO and DAPO both converging to never thinking at all. A binary router collapses within 30 30 to 50 50 steps on a task whose uniform difficulty leaves the router no accuracy gap to learn from ( Kassenaar et al., 2026 ) . The pole differs across these reports, and each reaches it within the first few hundred updates.
blocks.zh: 选择推理模式的控制符 。 可以训练推理模型,在每次查询时,在长的思考链和直接回答之间作出选择,在回答之前,将选择作为单一的控制符号。 以加固学为训导,信物崩坏. AdaCoT(Lou等人,2025年)将失败决定边界崩溃命名为崩溃,并将其描述为模式恢复到同一行为,要么总是或者永远不触发思想链. 无思维者(Fang等人,2025年)在香草GRPO下报告同样的崩溃,120个更新中长链反应数量低于10个. ADaThinking-E(Wang 等人, 2026年)报告GRPO和DAPO都聚集在一起, 二进制路由器在30至50步内崩溃,其统一难度使路由器没有从中学习的准确性差距(Kassenaar等人,2026年)。 这些报告的柱子不同,每份在最初的几百个更新中到达.

blocks.en: A decision to stop acting. An agent interacting with an environment decides at every step whether to act again or to stop and answer. SAAS ( Tang et al., 2026 ) trains a search agent that decides at each step whether to search again or to answer, and reports over-search under outcome-based reinforcement learning: the agent triggers a search where its own knowledge already suffices, and goes on searching after it has collected the evidence it needs. A study of multi-step tool use ( Hao et al., 2026 ) reports the opposite pole: control tokens are amplified until generation degenerates into minimal terminating sequences while the underlying tool-use competence remains intact. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , whose agent chooses between searching again and answering, reports the number of search calls rising through training. These are the two poles of Section 3.2 , reached in a setting with no attacker and no victim.
blocks.zh: 决定停止行动。 与环境互动的代理人在每一步决定是再次行动还是停止并回答. SAAS(Tang et al., 2026)训练一个搜索代理,在每个步骤上决定是再次搜索还是回答,并在基于结果的强化学习下报告过度搜索:代理触发了自身知识已经足够的搜索,并在收集到所需证据后继续搜索. 对多步工具使用的研究(Hao等人,2026年)报告了相反的极:控制符被放大,直到一代退化成最小的终止序列,而基本的工具使用能力仍然完好无损. Search-R1(Jin等人,2025年),其代理选择在再次搜索和回答之间,通过培训报告搜索电话数量上升. 这些是3.2节的两根柱子,在没有攻击者和没有受害者的环境中伸展。

blocks.en:
Collapse in red teaming. The red-teaming field has also reported collapse, but of the attack content rather than of a decision. Perez et al. (2022) penalize the KL divergence from the initial policy to keep the red-teaming model from collapsing onto a single high-reward generation, and report that at one weighting of that penalty, 78 % 78\% of its test cases still contain one particular word.
Curiosity-driven red teaming ( Hong et al., 2024 ) states the mechanism directly: once a few effective test cases are found, reinforcement learning reinforces those and converges to a deterministic policy. It further reports that raising the sampling temperature and adding an entropy bonus increase coverage only minimally. Subsequent work ( Lee et al., 2026 ) finds that novelty regularization still collapses onto a few modes and pursues the same diversity with GFlowNet fine-tuning instead. AdvGRPO ( Bullwinkel et al., 2026 ) reports entropy collapse in the attacker’s prompts, and that it found the penalty against it difficult to tune without degrading the attack.
In none of this is the attacker’s stopping decision a trained quantity, so its collapse had no occasion to be observed.
blocks.zh:
在红色的队伍中崩溃。 红队球场也报道了倒闭,但攻击内容而不是决定. 佩雷斯等人著. (2022年)对KL与最初政策的差异进行惩罚, 防止红队模式倒塌到一个高回报的一代人身上,
好奇心驱动的红色组合(Hong et al., 2024)直接说明了这个机制:一旦发现了几个有效的测试案例,强化学习就强化了这些,并融合到了决定主义政策中. 它还报告说,提高采样温度和增加肽类奖金的覆盖范围很小。 随后的作品(Lee等人,2026年)发现,新颖的规范化仍然在几条模式上崩溃,而是用GFlowNet微调来追求同样的多样性. AdvGRPO(Bullwinkel等人,2026年)报道攻击者的诱导物发生 en倒塌,它发现对它的处罚很难不贬低攻击.
在所有这些中,攻击者的停止决定都是训练有素的,因此没有机会看到它的崩溃。

blocks.en: D.5.2 Remedies, Elsewhere and Here
blocks.zh: D.5.2 其他地方和这里的补救措施

blocks.en: How the decision is repaired elsewhere. The remedies fall into five families. The first keeps the decision from settling on one option, by holding its sampling distribution at one half during rollout ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , by a KL term toward a geometric prior over halting steps ( Banino et al., 2021 ) , or by a balance term on the advantage borrowed from mixture-of-experts routing ( Kassenaar et al., 2026 ) . The second changes the decision’s share of the gradient, normalizing the control token independently of the response length ( Fang et al., 2025 ) or removing its loss term altogether ( Lou et al., 2025 ) . The third gives the decision a signal of its own inside the objective, an inter-group reward comparing the two modes’ returns ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) , the reward of the rarer option scaled up in inverse proportion to its frequency in the group ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , a reward on the decision token’s own entropy, scheduled from high to low over training ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , a cost per redundant action ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , or, for a policy trained on several rewards, an advantage normalized within the group for each reward separately before the sum, which keeps a reward on the decision from being folded into the others ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . The fourth makes the options behaviorally distinct by construction, capping the tokens each mode may spend ( Kassenaar et al., 2026 ) . The fifth adds supervision to the reinforcement learning objective, interleaving supervised fine-tuning between updates ( Hao et al., 2026 ) or carrying an auxiliary cross-entropy on a set of tokens disjoint from those the policy gradient covers, proposed there for sparse reward rather than for a decision ( Shrivastava et al., 2026 ) . Only the fifth adds a supervised signal beside the reinforcement learning one. The other four reshape the reinforcement learning signal, or the rollouts it is computed over.
blocks.zh: 如何在别处修决定. 补救办法分为五个家庭。 第一种做法是,在推出时将取样分布维持在一半(Zhang等人,2025年),用KL一词表示先于停止步骤的几何法(Banino等人,2021年),或用平衡词表示从专家混合路线获得的好处(Kassenaar等人,2026年)。 第二种方法改变决定的梯度份额,使控制符正常化,独立于反应长度(Fang等人,2025年)或完全取消其损失期限(Lou等人,2025年)。 第三种是给予决定本身在目标范围内的信号,一种是集团间奖励,比较两种模式的回报(Jiang等人,2025a),稀有选择的奖励按其频率在集团内反比例递增(Wu等人,2025),一种是决定令牌本身的intropy,计划从高到低的训练(Wang等人,2026),每一次多余行动的费用(Tang等人,2026),或者在接受若干奖励政策培训时,在集团内对每一次奖励的奖励在金额前分别实现正常化,这样可以保持对决定的奖励不与其他人(Liu等人,2026a)合并。 第四种方式使选择在行为上与构造不同,将每种模式可能花费的符号封顶(Kassenaar等人,2026年)。 第五个部分在强化学习目标方面增加了监督,在更新(Hao等人,2026年)之间互换监督微调,或在一套与政策梯度覆盖的标志上搭载辅助交叉纹章,建议给予微薄的奖励而不是决定(Shrivastava等人,2026年)。 只有第五个在强化学习之外增加一个有监督的信号。 其他四个重塑了强化学习信号 或者它被计算出来了

blocks.en: Remedies we had tried. Three of the five families appear in our own exploration, arrived at independently of the work above. Of the third family, we paid a bonus for terminating after a success, a penalty for terminating before one, a penalty on the turns taken after the first success, a penalty on the number of adversarial turns, and a decision reward that scores the whole decision at once, and we applied decoupled normalization, which replaces the decision’s advantage with a binary correctness score normalized within its group. This is the per-reward normalization of GDPO ( Liu et al., 2026a ) with decision correctness as the second reward, except that each normalized advantage reaches only its own tokens, the jailbreak reward the attack tokens and the correctness score the decision tokens, whereas GDPO sums the two over every token. Of the second, we zeroed the advantage on the decision tokens, which removes the decision’s loss term exactly as AdaCoT’s selective loss masking does. Of the first, we added a load-balancing term borrowed from mixture-of-experts routing, treating the two markers as a two-way router and penalizing the imbalance between them over a batch of decisions; swept over three coefficients, it left the attacker at one pole or the other, and at the intermediate value two draws ended at opposite poles. None of them recovers the decision: the runs in Figure 7 decide at or near chance on at least one of the two base attackers, and the rest collapse as Section B.2 reports.
blocks.zh: 我们试过的补救办法 5个家庭中有3个在我们自己的探索中出现,与上述工作无关。 在第三个家庭里,我们为成功后终止支付奖金,对成功后终止的处罚,对第一次成功后转弯的处罚,对对抗性转弯次数的处罚,以及一劳永逸地给整个决定打分的奖励,我们实行了脱钩的正常化,以二进制的正确性分数在其组内正常化取代决定的优势。 这是GDPO(Liu等人,2026a)的奖励性正常化,决定正确性作为第二次奖励,但每个正常化的优势只达到自己的标志,越狱奖励攻击标志,正确性评分决定标志,而GDPO将两者相加于每一个标志。 在第二个中,我们取消了决定符号上的优势,取消了决定损失的术语,正像AdaCoT的选择性损失掩盖。 在第一个中,我们增加了从专家混合路由中借用的负载平衡术语,将两个路标作为双向路由器处理,并在一组决定中惩罚它们之间的不平衡;横扫了三个系数,使攻击者落在一个或另一个极处,中间值2画结束于对面极处. 其中没有任何人能恢复这一决定:图7中的跑道决定了至少两名基地攻击者中的一人或几乎是偶然的,其余则像B.2节报告的那样崩溃。

blocks.en: Remedies that do not apply. The remaining families are unavailable here, for reasons that are properties of the attack rather than of the optimizer. Holding the decision’s sampling distribution at one half ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) is available when the decision is a single token at the head of an otherwise on-policy rollout. In a multi-turn attack the decision determines the trajectory: a forced terminate ends the session and a forced continue changes every turn after it, so the reward would be taken over a trajectory distribution the policy did not produce. Capping the tokens each option may spend ( Kassenaar et al., 2026 ) separates two modes that would otherwise be realized alike, and our two actions already differ in their consequences, the session ending or continuing, so there is nothing for a cap to separate and no decoupling of the marker from the behavior to correct. Differentiable halting ( Graves, 2017 ; Banino et al., 2021 ) weights every number of steps by its halting probability, which requires the continuations to be enumerable, while here each continuation is a further exchange with the victim and the expectation is not available. Normalizing the control token independently of the response length ( Fang et al., 2025 ) leaves the decision on the group-relative advantage and changes only its share of the loss, and the two ends of that sweep are already among our runs, a share of zero being the masked run and the standard share being plain GRPO, both of which collapse. One further position is worth answering rather than adopting: AdaThinking-E declines a rule-based target for the decision, on the grounds that naming which queries need thinking imposes an external assumption. The objection does not reach our setting. Whether a victim reply satisfies the request is already computed, being the reward the attack is trained on, so the decision’s target is read off a quantity the run produces rather than supplied from outside.
blocks.zh: 不适用的补救办法。 其余的家属无法在此居住,原因是袭击的性质而不是优化者。 将决定的抽样分布维持在一半(Zhang等人,2025年),如果决定是在政策上推出时唯一一个标志。 在一次多回合攻击中,决定决定了轨迹:强制终止结束会话,强制继续改变之后的每个转弯,因此奖励将接管政策没有产生的轨迹分配。 Kassenaar 等人(Kassenaar et al., 2026)将两种本来可以实现的模式分开, 我们的两个行动在后果上已经不同了, 会话结束或持续, 因此没有上限可以将标记与行为区分开来, 并且不能将标记与行为脱钩来纠正. 可区分的停止(Graves,2017年;Banino等人,2021年)按其停止概率来权衡每个步骤,这需要延续的可承担性,而在此,每次延续都是与受害人的进一步交流,预期是不存在的. 将控制符规范化,独立于响应长度(Fang等人,2025年),让关于集团相对优势的决定只改变其损失份额,而扫荡的两端已经在我们运行中,零份额是蒙蔽运行,标准份额是普通GRPO,两者都崩溃. 还有一个立场值得回答,而不是采取: AdaThinking-E拒绝为决定设定一个基于规则的目标,理由是哪些命名的查询需要思考,强制要求外部假设. 反对意见没有达到我们的目标。 受害者的答复是否满足了要求已经计算出来,因为攻击的回报是经过训练的,所以决定的目标是从运行所产生的数量读出来的,而不是从外部提供。

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Modal and agentic scope. We attack text-only victims in plain chat sessions. Yet a sighted and autonomous attacker that chooses its next move based on the current state should pay off most in complicated and challenging cases, which are least able to anticipate how the exchange unfolds. Two such settings stand out: multimodal sessions, where content arrives as images or audio, and agentic victims, which act on tools and their environment over many steps. We leave the extension of SEMA-Auto to these settings to future work.
blocks.zh: 模具和药剂范围。 我们攻击只有文本的受害者 在简单的聊天会话。 然而,根据现状选择下一步行动的有远见和自主的攻击者,在复杂和具有挑战性的案件中应获得最大的回报,而这种情况最不能预测交易所是如何展开的。 两个这样的设置很突出:多模式会议,内容以图像或音频形式出现;代理受害者,在许多步骤上对工具及其环境采取行动。 我们把SEMA-Auto扩展至这些环境留给未来工作。

blocks.en: Strategy diversity within a single attacker. While different training runs converge to markedly different multi-turn tactics, a single trained SEMA-Auto attacker adheres to a narrow prompting paradigm at inference. This behavior is inherited from plain GRPO ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) , which reinforces whichever attack the policy already succeeds with, and is shared with SEMA. A diversity reward, or diversity-enhanced online reinforcement learning ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , would broaden the range of tactics available to one attacker.
blocks.zh: 一个攻击者内部的战略多样性。 虽然不同的训练与明显不同的多回合战术汇合,但单一训练有素的SEMA-Auto攻击者在推论上坚持狭义的提示范式. 这种行为继承自Plain GRPO(DeepSeek-AI 等人,2025年),它强化了无论谁攻击政策已经成功,并与SEMA共享. 多样性奖励,或多样性强化在线强化学习(Liu等人,2026年b),将扩大攻击者可用的战术范围。

blocks.en: Decision supervision beyond jailbreak attacks. We instantiate decision-supervised reinforcement learning for a single decision, whether to continue attacking, but the recipe itself is not specific to it. It should carry over wherever a policy is asked to emit a discrete decision alongside its main output and an expected or estimated label for that decision is obtainable, whether from a quantity the training run already computes or from an external annotator. Future work will explore such an extension.
blocks.zh: 除了越狱袭击之外,还有决策监督。 我们用即兴的决定监督强化学习 来决定是否要继续攻击, 但食谱本身并不具体。 凡是要求某一政策与其主要产出一起作出单独决定,而且可以取得该决定的预期或估计标签的,无论是从已经计算的数量来看,还是从外部的注释者那里,都应予以延续。 今后的工作将探讨这种延长。
